vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #2107 (adopt xBRIEF v0.8 schema); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Adopt xBRIEF v0.8 schema; pin types and validator

narratives.Description: Vendor the xBRIEF v0.8 core schema into directive and pin the engine constants to it so the validator accepts the new contract. This story is independently buildable because it only changes the vendored schema file and two constants modules without touching migration or rename logic.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add the vendored schema file content/vbrief/schemas/xbrief-core-0.8.schema.json and point the validator constants module at it. 2. Update packages/types/src/constants.ts (VBRIEF_VERSION 0.6->0.8, reference prefix x-vbrief/->x-xbrief/, schema $id) and packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/constants.ts to accept the xBRIEFInfo root key and the auto status; add unit tests that assert a v0.8 document validates and new optional fields are accepted.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the engine pinned to the xBRIEF v0.8 schema, so that the validator accepts xBRIEFInfo, version 0.8, and x-xbrief/ references.

items.title: Given a v0.8 document, when validated, then it passes with xBRIEFInfo and version 0.8

narrative.Acceptance: Given a document carrying xBRIEFInfo and version 0.8, when the validator runs, then it returns a pass without unknown-key errors.

items.title: Given new optional fields, when validated, then absence and presence both pass

narrative.Acceptance: Given PlanItem.type, summary, planRefs, and Source/Confidence narrative keys, when present or absent, then the validator accepts both and never requires them.

items.title: Given x-xbrief reference types, when validated, then the prefix resolves as conformant

narrative.Acceptance: Given references whose type begins with x-xbrief/, when the validator runs, then it records them as conformant reference types.

expected_outputs: packages/types pinned to v0.8; validator accepts xBRIEFInfo + version 0.8 + x-xbrief/ references

references.title: Issue #2107: feat(vbrief): adopt xBRIEF v0.8 schema -- pin types + validator
